items.explanation: Learners develop reading time on clocks. The idea should be represented, discussed, practised and then applied in a new context.
key_questions: What does reading time on clocks mean?
How can you represent or check it?
Where could you use it outside this exercise?
items.misconception_risk: Confusing the representation or unit with the quantity itself; always check using an equivalent representation.

key_rules: 24-hour p.m. time after 12:00 is found by adding 12 to the 12-hour hour.
Elapsed time can be found by counting forward from start to finish or subtracting times carefully.
